name: Normal Scenario: Unequal Sequence Batch
rationale: Unequal lengths require rectangular padding and attention masking so self-attention ignores pad tokens.

name: Boundary Scenario: Smallest Valid Input (Minimal Boundary)
rationale: Minimal valid input: single token sequence in 2D batch [1, 1]. All sequences are equal length (1) within limit (512); no padding needed.

name: Missing-Information Scenario: None Input
rationale: Missing sequence tokens cannot form an input tensor for model forward pass.

name: Boundary Scenario: Unbatched 1D Sequence (Dimension Boundary)
rationale: Unbatched 1D list triggers dimension mismatch because Transformer models expect a 2D tensor [batch_size, seq_len].

name: Boundary Scenario: Exact Maximum Model Context (Upper Boundary)
rationale: Sequence fits exactly within the 512 token context window.

name: Boundary Scenario: Exceeding Maximum Model Context (Upper Boundary + 1)
rationale: Exceeding max context window (513 > 512) violates position embedding limits.
